## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Java</b> (spoiler) · <code>1679-max-number-of-k-sum-pairs.java</code></summary>

```java
class Solution {
    public int maxOperations(int[] nums, int k) {
        Arrays.sort(nums);
        int pairs = 0;
        int n = nums.length;
        int left = 0;
        int right = n-1;

        while (left < right){
            int sum = nums[left] + nums[right];
            if(sum == k){
                left++;
                right--;
                pairs++;
            }else if(sum < k){
                left++;
            }else{
                right--;
            }
        }

        return pairs;
    }
}
```

</details>
